name: year
description: Calendar year in which the financial year of the observation ends
observations: Partition column; the financial year 2024-25 ends in 2025 so is stored as 2025

name: financial_year
description: Australian financial year of the observation in YYYY-YY format
observations: Runs 1 July to 30 June such as 2024-25

name: series_id
description: ABS series identifier linking the observation to the series table
observations: Foreign key to the au_abs_national_accounts series table

name: value
description: Observed value of the series for the financial year
observations: Unit varies by series and is given in the series table so no fixed measurement unit is set here
